name: Gus the Itsy-Bitsy Knight
description:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy, Gus, who wanted to become a great knight. Sorry, not a great knight… The Greatest knight in the whole kingdom of Karamel. Wielding with his laser sword, mounted on his electric pony, Gus never misses an opportunity to go on an adventure to accomplish all his missions.

The problem is, Gus is… ITSY BITSY! He stands three apples high, to be precise, but has a heart the size of a house! Gus will prove to one and all that a brave heart can overcome everything, and that there’s no greater cavalier than Gus, the itsy bitsy knight!

videos.title: Gus, the Itsy Bitsy Knight with a Big Big Heart!
videos.overview: Meet  GUS – The Itsy Bitsy Knight – a little boy who has a big dream to become the greatest knight in the Karamel Kingdom! Despite the fact that GUS is very small, he has a big kind heart, and his courage can only be envied. He is not afraid of witches, trolls, or dragons, and he is always ready to come to the rescue of those who are in trouble. Armed with a laser sword and magical shield, GUS bravely sets out to perform heroic acts on his electric pony.

videos.title: Gadgets of Gus
videos.overview: Gus owns a lot of high-tech electronic gadgets, and the best part about them is that they are all Tyler's inventions! Let's check out the gadgets that the itsy bitsy knight owns with Grandpa Merlin.

videos.title: Karamel's Rogues
videos.overview: Find out everything about the Rogues of Karamel Kingdom, featuring Gus, Troll Trollington, Shadow Knight, and the one & only Warticious!

videos.title: Best Friends
videos.overview: Friends make everything beautiful. Do you have friends like Gus, Tyler, Iris, Diane, Arthur, and Rosie?

videos.title: K-Knight Pippy
videos.overview: Dogs are our best friends and Pippy is Gus' best friend too! On this International Dog Day let's celebrate the pooches who fill our lives with joy, unconditional love, and loyalty. Because there is nothing better than coming home to a wagging tail!

videos.title: Warticious and her Groaties
videos.overview: Let's meet Warticious - the cousin of our itsy bitsy knight Gus. She is a witch who wants to steal Grandpa Merlin's wand to become the most powerful witch in the Karamel Kingdom.

videos.title: Bug Stompers!
videos.overview: The Shadow Knight's castle is overrun with roaches!

videos.title: Party Crashers!
videos.overview: Even robots need to relax. But they soon find an uninvted guest is here to spoil their holiday!

videos.title: Troublesome Frogs!
videos.overview: A frog causes trouble for the inhabitants of a lake.

videos.title: Archery
videos.overview: Watch what happened when the Knight Knights tried their hands at archery.

videos.title: Ew, Stinky!
videos.overview: On a bright sunny day, a rabbit emerges from its burrow and stretches, enjoying the lovely fresh air… until a very smelly green stink line wafts over and disappears up its nostrils. Ew! What is that?!

videos.title: Warticious finds her Prince Charming
videos.overview: Warticious wants to turn one of the pirate frogs into Prince Charming.

videos.title: Medie-ball Madness!
videos.overview: The Knight-Knights embark on a crazy and very comical game of Medie-ball!

videos.title: Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Using a map, the pirate frogs embark on a treasure hunt. But Darg the dragon is in their path.

videos.title: Magical Creatures
videos.overview: Grandpa Merlin is the greatest magician in Karamel Kingdom. That's why he needs to keep his magic lab protected. What happens when the magical gargoyle that guards his lab sees a butterfly?

videos.title: Ball Game
videos.overview: Pippy is playing ball on the Karamel Castle terrace. He’s having fun. But it would be even more fun if he had someone to play with...

videos.title: The Guard Dog
videos.overview: Ready for some more Pippy cuteness? Watch the video to know what happens when the Knight Knights sneak into the palace.

videos.title: FlyCatcher!
videos.overview: It’s a perfect day for a picnic! Troy arrives at the edge of the marshlands, ready to make the most of it. He’s accompanied by his three favorite flies, a very buzzy trio! They’re so buzzy that they attract the attention of three pirate frogs!

videos.title: Dragon Fight
videos.overview: The Knight Knights fight with Darg and Stinky Dragon. But who wins?

videos.title: Awesome Knight Stuff!
videos.overview: Gus is super happy to display his awesome knight’s accessories.

videos.title: The Legend of Gus
videos.overview: Gus is keen to follow in Adam's footsteps: at the same age, he had already tamed a Stinky-Dragon.

videos.title: Supercharge Me
videos.overview: After losing in a tournament, Gus is frustrated by the slowness of his vehicle.

videos.title: A Bit Too Itsy-Bitsy!
videos.overview: Gus wins a replica of Sir Adam the Hard One's armor in a competition, but it's way too big for him.

videos.title: The Three Challenges
videos.overview: Daddy King won the King's Dragons Cup with flying colors when he was Gus' age. Eager to do the same, Gus tackles Shadow Knight in a contest.

videos.title: Rude-Speak
videos.overview: After a spell mess-up by Iris, Daddy King and Mommy Queen get a bout of "Rude-Speak".

videos.title: The Big-Bite Knight
videos.overview: Following Grandpa Merlin's advice, Gus decides to face the object of his recurring nightmare - a Giant Knight-Knight - head-on.

videos.title: King of The Ring
videos.overview: Gus "borrows" Daddy King's ring to use it as a game piece in a board game.

videos.title: Rosie's Treasure
videos.overview: Gus and Rosie chance upon a map which look like it might lead them to the place where Rosie's parents used to live!

videos.title: Super Shadow Knight
videos.overview: Shadow Knight becomes the kingdom's darling overnight by performing a string of feats worthy of a great knight.

videos.title: Funny Knight-Knights
videos.overview: Gus takes in a wounded Knight-Knight and cares for him. But the little rascal steals our itsy bitsy friend's laser sword!

videos.title: From K-9 to K-Knight!
videos.overview: On Daddy King's advice, Gus is planning to train Pippy, to make his pooch "knightlike!"

videos.title: Sweet-Smelling Slug Slime
videos.overview: Disguised as a street vendor, Troy manages to contaminate the Karamelians, gradually turning a bunch of them into trolls.

videos.title: Floppy
videos.overview: During a charity event, Gus decides to part with Floppy, the plush toy he had when he was a baby.

videos.title: The Beast of Drool Fang
videos.overview: Pippy has been turned into smelly beast; Gus tries to stop Pippy from felling rejected.

videos.title: Princess Candy
videos.overview: When a queen from a neighboring kingdom comes to visit Karamel, Daddy King entrusts Gus and Iris to look after the queen's daughter, Candy.

videos.title: Grateful Dragon Alert!
videos.overview: Gus is bored. Keen to accomplish a new feat, he "provokes adventure." But in so doing, he entices Darg to Karamel Castle.

videos.title: What A Team!
videos.overview: Gus and his friends have to play against the Knight-Knights in a medieval match.

videos.title: The Unicorn
videos.overview: Gus spots a unicorn: it's been lured into Karamel Kingdom by a magic snare!

videos.title: Out Of Tune
videos.overview: Rosie auditions to accompany Arthur at the Queen's Festival. But she sings horribly out of tune...unbeknownst to Arthur!

videos.title: Back to The Middle Ages
videos.overview: A storm hits Karamel and the castle's electronics stop working; Warticious jumps on this chance.

videos.title: Detective Gus
videos.overview: Grandpa Merlin has gone missing! Detective Oswald Smellborne is called in by a very worried Mommy Queen.

videos.title: Many Gus' Mess
videos.overview: Gus asks his sister to help him replicate himself so he can keep all of his promises.

videos.title: How Trolly-Trolly
videos.overview: While on a visit to Karamel, a sovereign from another kingdom expresses distaste regarding a troll he came across on his way to the castle.

videos.title: Kray-Z-Fie's Spear
videos.overview: While on a fishing trip, Gus pulls a mysterious chest out of the water.

videos.title: Itsy Bitsy Tooth
videos.overview: There's a dragon wreaking havoc in the kingdom and Daddy King need to handle it. Gus is told he's too small for a mission of this nature.

videos.title: Victor The Hardy One
videos.overview: When a dangerous dragon is at large, Mommy Queen calls upon Victor the Hardy One; Gus joins Victor on his quest.

videos.title: The Golden Bucket
videos.overview: The Shadow Knight accidentally finds a magic bucket that turns everything into gold.

videos.title: So Lucky!
videos.overview: Gus finds a pretty little rock embellished with magic symbols, which turns out to be a lucky charm!

videos.title: Like Grandfather, Like Father, Like Son
videos.overview: To keep the kingdom safe, Grandpa Merlin and Daddy King perform a ritual to put the spirit to sleep.

videos.title: The Rhinopuff
videos.overview: Gus takes in an injured Rhinopuff and promises to take it back to the marshlands once it is healthy.

videos.title: You've Made Your Cake, Now Eat It!
videos.overview: Diane and Warticious both get to the finals of a baking contest. Warticious captures her rival and locks her in her house.

videos.title: Once a Pest, Always a Pest?
videos.overview: Gus believes he can change Warticious just by being nice to her.

videos.title: The Cup-and-Ball Knight
videos.overview: Gus would do anything to be a part of the same prestigious club as his father.

videos.title: Cleaning is King!
videos.overview: Gus forgets to wash his hands after touching some magic powder.

videos.title: True Bravery
videos.overview: Gus chances upon Sir Adam the Hardy One's own personal sword, but he must complete three challenges.

videos.title: Magic Day
videos.overview: Gus is chosen to hand out replica Mighty Magic Wands to young Karamelians for Magic Day.

videos.title: Friends For Life
videos.overview: Tyler and Arthur fall out and don't want to be around each other; Gus pretends he's lost his memory.

videos.title: Hidden Hero
videos.overview: Tyler accidentally unearths a Mandragor, a plant that poses a threat to the kingdom.

videos.title: If You Can Hear It, You Can Know It!
videos.overview: After Warticious messes up one of her spells, Gus is able to hear everything she says to her fans through her crystal ball.

videos.title: The Impossible Race
videos.overview: Gus needs to ride a Mossmonster in a race against Shadow Knight and his dragon mount Darg.

videos.title: Come Back Tyler!
videos.overview: Gus leaves his friend Tyler to go and play competitive games with a young villager named Amaury.

videos.title: Impatient Gus
videos.overview: Gus is itching to get a new knight figurine but is told he must wait until his birthday.

videos.title: The Ghost of Karamel
videos.overview: Gus has been crying wolf so often that when he claims he’s met a ghost who needs his help, nobody believes him.

videos.title: Tyler's Secret
videos.overview: Warticious has gotten hold of a photo of Tyler, mocking King Excelsior behind the man’s back!

videos.title: Click!
videos.overview: In a clumsy move, Gus casts a spell on Diane’s parchment-cam: now, it numbs anyone who happens to be in its field of vision!

videos.title: Memory Loss
videos.overview: Gus thinks that everyone forgot today is the anniversary of when he was knighted and uses a magic potion designed to jog their memories.

videos.title: The Blue Stone
videos.overview: When Gus finds a pretty blue stone at the bottom of the lake, he decides he’ll gift it to his mom.

videos.title: Magic Iris
videos.overview: Iris wants to give up trying to be a magician: her long string of failed spells have not gone unnoticed by her witchy cousin!

videos.title: E-Pip
videos.overview: To avoid endangering his pooch during certain missions, Gus has asked Tyler to make him a robot replica of Pippy!

videos.title: The Poisoned Lake
videos.overview: After an incident in the marshlands with his electric pony, Gus notices he’s polluted the frogs’ environment a tad.

videos.title: Dragon Permit Part 1
videos.overview: Gus must tame a dragon, but despite his efforts, his Valiant proves unpredictable.

videos.title: Dragon Permit Part 2
videos.overview: Gus discovers that his dragon belongs to someone else; he must let him go.

videos.title: A Day In The Life Of A Knight
